I would like to formally contest the current assessed value of my property based on several factors that negatively impact its market value:

1, Increase in Crime Rates
Recent increases in crime within the surrounding area have made the neighborhood less desirable, which can directly affect property values and buyer demand.

2. Decline in Neighborhood Maintenance
There has been a noticeable lack of up keep among several properties in the neighborhood. Poor property maintenance and deferred repairs in nearby homes can diminish overall curb appeal and reduce the market value of surrounding properties.
